draft.purpose: Remeasure directly under group-Key identities instead of migrating old labels.
draft.key_binding_rule: Finalize and hash every Kernel Key before obtaining its latency; specification_id is not a measurement Kernel ID.

measurement_recipe.order: predeclare order_seed; alternate device and implementation block order; retain all observations
measurement_recipe.kernel_timing: GPU_event_duration; no CPU/native fallback for the fused label
measurement_recipe.cost_timing: record setup, compile/warmup, numeric validation, restore and formal sampling wall separately and retain total; two-method diagnostics are not a one-query cost
measurement_recipe.invalid_or_drifted_samples: retain original records and report status; do not rerun until success or silently discard

data_policy.profile_ingestion: Validate raw-record lineage and matching finalized Kernel identity before ingestion.
